# sdmApp 0.0.3

## Breaking and infrastructure changes

* Dropped the archived `rgdal` and `rgeos` dependencies. `sdmApp` now
  relies on `raster` (>= 3.6.3), which reaches GDAL, GEOS and PROJ through
  `terra`, so the package installs again on current R.
* Reworked `DESCRIPTION`: packages actually used by the exported functions
  moved to `Imports`; the modelling engines used only inside the shiny
  interface stay in `Suggests` and are checked at launch.
* `NAMESPACE` is now generated by roxygen2 from targeted `@importFrom`
  tags instead of a blanket `exportPattern()` and long `@import` lists.

## Shiny interface rewrite

* The interface now works on `terra` rasters and `sf` points throughout.
  It only converts to `raster`/`sp` when calling `CENFA`, which does not
  support the newer classes. Rasters are read with `terra::rast()` instead
  of `SSDM::load_var()`; layers with a different grid are aligned on the
  first one.
* The seven model pages (Bioclim, Domain, Mahalanobis, GLM, MaxEnt, Random
  Forest, SVM) share a single shiny module backed by one cross-validation
  function, replacing seven copy-pasted controllers.
* Models can be cross-validated on the spatial blocks built in the Spatial
  blocking tab. The "with spatial blocking" option was previously offered
  but not implemented.
* Fixed: the k-fold training and test sets were built with a recycled
  logical index, so models were trained and evaluated on the wrong points.
* Fixed: GLM maps and thresholds were on the log-odds scale; they are now
  probabilities.
* Fixed: loading a csv/txt occurrence file left an empty table (it was
  re-read with `nrows = 0`), and the decimal mark option was ignored.
* Fixed: only the Bioclim page had working download buttons; every model
  page now downloads its map (png, pdf or GeoTIFF), evaluation, response
  and variable importance plots.
* Fixed: the app state lived in `global.R`, so on a shared shiny-server all
  users saw the same data. State is now created per session.
* Fixed: the Spatial Analysis and Modeling menus shared one selection, so
  both opened on an empty page, and observers were re-registered on every
  render.
* Fixed: listing drives used `wmic`, which is removed from recent Windows
  11 builds; the file choosers now use `shinyFiles::getVolumes()`.
* The "Save Script" button now downloads the generated R script, which
  reloads the user's data.
* Response curves and variable importance are drawn with `ggplot2` for
  every method; variable importance is shown for Random Forest and MaxEnt.
* Removed the "Combining model" button, which had no page behind it.
* Dropped the interface's use of `SSDM`, `shinydashboard`, `shinyBS`,
  `rhandsontable`, `data.table`, `dplyr`, `tidyr` and `stringr`; `rJava`
  is now only needed for MaxEnt.
* The interface code is styled with `styler` and linted along with the
  rest of the package; its helpers and server are covered by tests.

## blockCV 3.0+ support

* `sdmApp_fold_Explorer()` now accepts the objects returned by
  `blockCV::cv_spatial()` and the other `cv_*()` functions of blockCV 3.0
  and later, while still accepting legacy `SpatialBlock` objects.
* The shiny interface's "Spatial autocorrelation" and "Spatial blocking"
  tabs now call `cv_spatial_autocor()`, `cv_spatial()` and `cv_plot()`
  instead of `spatialAutoRange()`, `spatialBlock()` and `summarise_fold()`,
  which no longer exist in blockCV. `blockCV (>= 3.0.0)` is now required.

## New features

* `sdmApp_PA()`, `sdmApp_RasterPlot()`, `sdmApp_TimesRasters()` and
  `sdmApp_fold_Explorer()` accept `terra::SpatRaster` objects as well as
  `raster` objects.

## Fixes

* The `theme` argument of `sdmApp()` is honoured again. `global.R` checked
  for a shiny option (`sdmAppInvoked`) that `sdmApp()` never set, so the
  deployment defaults always overwrote the chosen theme and referenced a
  non-existent JavaScript file.
* `sdmApp()` restores the global `options()` it changes once the app stops,
  rejects non-positive or vector `maxRequestSize` values instead of
  silently replacing them, validates `debug`, and lets `...` override
  `launch.browser`.
* `sdmApp_PA()` labels presence and absence by value rather than by
  position, so a raster holding only presences is no longer shown as
  "Absence"; non-binary rasters are rejected.
* `sdmApp_TimesRasters()` checks that both rasters share extent, resolution
  and CRS.
* `sdmApp_fold_Explorer()` rejects fold index 0 and non-integer indices,
  colours points by the column the folds were built on (instead of the
  first column), and uses `linewidth` for block outlines.
* `stringr` and `sp`, used by the shiny interface, are declared in
  `Suggests` and checked at launch; unused `graphics` import removed;
  invalid placeholder ORCID removed from `DESCRIPTION`.

* `sdmApp()` no longer calls itself recursively and builds the shiny app
  only once. It validates `theme` and `maxRequestSize` up front and stops
  with an informative message listing any missing suggested packages.
* Replaced the deprecated `ggplot2::aes_string()` with `aes()` and
  `.data[[ ]]` across the mapping helpers.
* Replaced `guides(fill = FALSE)` with `guides(fill = "none")`.
* Replaced fragile `class(x) == "SpatialBlock"` comparisons with
  `inherits()`.
* Added input validation to `sdmApp_PA()`, `sdmApp_RasterPlot()`,
  `sdmApp_TimesRasters()` and `sdmApp_fold_Explorer()`.

## Testing and CI

* Replaced the placeholder unit tests with real tests that exercise the
  exported functions against the bundled example data.
* Rebuilt the GitHub Actions workflows (`R-CMD-check`, `pkgdown`,
  `test-coverage`, `lint`) on `r-lib/actions` v2 and current runners.
  The lint workflow now lives in `.github/workflows/` (it previously sat at
  the repository root and never ran) and is configured by `.lintr`.

# sdmApp 0.0.2

* First public version.
